const factory = {
  constructor(): number {
    return "bad";
  },
};
const n: number = factory.constructor();
console.log(n);
const empty = {
  constructor(): number {},
};
class Base {}
class Derived extends Base {
  constructor() {
    super();
  }
  make() {
    return {
      constructor() {
        super();
      },
    };
  }
}
class Plain {
  constructor(public x: number) {}
}
console.log(new Plain(1).x, empty, Derived);
